_doc: The AI Apps gateway's plan refusal (OTLP /v1/traces|logs|metrics and the SDK control API /v1/sdk/*), as every SDK's one pure parser reads it. A plan refusal is an HTTP 403 whose body's error is plan_required, or an HTTP 429 whose body's error is planea_events_quota_exceeded or planea_bytes_quota_exceeded, AND whose body carries a non-empty upgrade_url (a 429 over the org's OWN cap has none and is not a plan refusal). Every field is at the top level of the body (on /v1/sdk/* beside api_version and request_id); plan, allowance and plans may be absent, an allowance axis may be absent (no cap). The parser never raises: anything else (another code or status, a body that is not a JSON object, an empty body) is null. Each case gives status, headers, body (a JSON object, or a string: the raw body text) and want: null, or the fields the parser must read. kind is plan_required (403) or allowance_exceeded (429). message, when want has it, is the body's message (without one the SDK's own default line is not compared). plan_name / plan_version / plan_label are the plan in force; no plan_name means no plan (a plan, or an offered plan, without a string name is left out). plans lists the offered plans' names in order; offered_allowance is the first one's allowance. allowance compares axis by axis, an axis absent from want.allowance reads as no cap, and no allowance in want means none was read. No quota in want means none; no retry_after_seconds means no (or no readable) Retry-After header, which is integer seconds. A field of the wrong type is left out, never an error. Python runs these in sdk/python/tests/test_plan_refusal.py, TypeScript in sdk/typescript/test/planrefusal.test.mjs, Go in sdk/go/planrefusal_test.go, Java in sdk/java/src/test/java/app/superbased/sdk/PlanRefusalTest.java. ai_gateway_cases (hosted AI gateway lane L4) are the AI gateway's plan refusals, which arrive in the error dialect of the endpoint called (the gateway's own {error: message, reason: code}, the OpenAI SDKs' {error: {message, type, param, code}} or the Anthropic SDKs' {type: error, error: {type, message, details: {error_code}}}), always with the code at the top-level reason and the plan detail (capability org.aigateway, plan, allowance, plans, upgrade_url) and quota at the top level beside the envelope. A parser reads the code from reason when it is a non-empty string, else from error when error is a string; the message from error when it is a string, else from error.message. The AI gateway's plan refusals are a 403 plan_required or a 429 aigw_requests_quota_exceeded with a non-empty upgrade_url; its allowance axes are requests_monthly and concurrency, and its quota carries allowance (the allowance before grace) beside limit (the hard stop that refused). A 429 aigw_concurrency_exceeded (retry in a second), a 503 aigw_meter_unavailable, and a quota refusal over the organization's own cap (no upgrade_url) are not plan refusals. The four SDKs' parsers do not read ai_gateway_cases yet: the SDK lane (L8) adds the parsing and the test loop over them.
